title: Waitlist offered
description: A place freed and the worker offered it to the next waitlist entry that fits, as a short hold owned by that customer. The entry follows the offered booking's fate: a confirmation accepts it, a lapse offers it to the next entry. `offeredBookingId` is the hold to poll or to confirm through the Tenant's own flow. The event's `aggregate` is `waitlist/<waitlistEntryId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

position.description: How many waiting entries were ahead of this one when it was offered; informational, not a reorderable rank.

offeredBookingId.description: The HELD booking created for this entry; confirming it accepts the offer.

offeredUntil.description: When the offer lapses and the next entry is tried.
